stories.title: Kash Patel says that AI use at the FBI has 'increased by 605%' since he became director — claims that every major tech player is 'embedded' in the agency

sources.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel stated in an interview that he's responsible for a "605% increase" in the bureau's usage of AI. The problem is that it's hard to pin down what the figure refers to.
sources.summary_zh: FBI 局长卡什·帕特尔 (Kash Patel) 在接受采访时表示，他对联邦调查局人工智能的使用量“增加了 605%”负有责任。问题是很难确定这个数字指的是什么。

sources.summary: PS Audio and Naim had to cease production of two Hi-Fi models as manufacturers quit making optical drives, even as CD and vinyl have hit record sales in recent months.
sources.summary_zh: 由于制造商停止生产光驱，PS Audio 和 Naim 不得不停止生产两款 Hi-Fi 型号，尽管近几个月来 CD 和黑胶唱片的销量创下了纪录。
